scripts.build: npm run catalog:generate && npm run build --workspace @npati/agent-api && npm run build --workspace @npati/web
scripts.cert:scale: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml run --rm scale-certifier
scripts.cert:scale:smoke: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml run --rm scale-certifier node scripts/run-scale-certification.mjs --smoke
scripts.cert:scale:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml up -d scale-api-a scale-api-b
scripts.cert:scale:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml rm -s -f scale-api-a scale-api-b
